parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
M1: Use the product rule correctly on $y=x\cos2x$, attempting $(dx/dx)\cos2x+x\,d(\cos2x)/dx$. A1: Obtain a correct derivative such as $\cos2x-2x\sin2x$. A1FT: Obtain $dy/dx=-1$ and $y=-\frac12\pi$ when $x=\frac12\pi$, following through their derivative as printed. A1 CWO: Obtain $x+y=0$, or equivalent; both $y$ and $dy/dx$ at $x=\frac12\pi$ must be shown.
Total: [4]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Integrate by parts and reach a form $ax\sin2x+b\int\sin2x\,dx$. A1: Obtain $\frac12x\sin2x-\frac12\int\sin2x\,dx$, or equivalent. A1: Complete the integration to obtain $\frac12x\sin2x+\frac14\cos2x$, or equivalent. DM1: Use limits $x=0$ and $x=\frac\pi4$ in the correct order after integrating twice to an expression $ax\sin2x+c\cos2x$; allow at most one substitution error. A1 ISW: Obtain $\frac\pi8-\frac14$, or an exact simplified two-term equivalent; accept $(\pi-2)/8$.
Total: [5]
